name: hr_selfservice
summary: Employee self-service requests with a manager approval inbox and an HR service desk (queues, categories, cases with SLA timers, message thread and append-only history)
description: Gives ordinary employees one place to raise and track HR requests and cases, and managers a consolidated approval inbox, without recreating any existing HR data. An HR service desk follows the proven helpdesk pattern as a self-contained module: configurable queues and categories carrying response / resolution hour windows, categorized cases (letters, certificates, personal-info changes, general) with assignment, an SLA clock snapshotted at first assignment, a message thread, an append-only audit of every change, and a scheduled scan that durably flags breaches. A unified self-service request (leave / attendance correction / overtime / personal info / letter) routes to the employee's own reporting manager for a maker-checker approve or reject - deciding only records a decision and never posts a cost, creates leave or mutates pay. Ownership is isolated at the data layer with read-only record rules on a dedicated self-service group so an employee sees only their own records while an HR Officer / Manager sees everything. Extends the hr anchor; navigated under the single HR app.
author: Nexa
